messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick sync — we need to lock the webinar topic + run-of-show. Two candidate angles: 1) "Predictable inference: balancing latency & cost at scale" (benchmarks + Optimize demo) or 2) "Serving-first architectures: lessons from production" (arch + fallbacks). Which one gives better lead follow-up hooks?
raj (Growth): leaning to the latency+cost angle. Clear KPIs = easier to gate MQLs.
olivia (Product): +1. We can show 2 short benchmark slides (tokens/sec and $/k tokens) and a 5-min Optimize walkthrough.
kevin (Sales): Agree. Also need an explicit CTA: "request a tailored cost review" that maps to SDR routing. How do we tag "hot" leads?
sam (DevRel): Rehearsal availability: Wed 9am PT or Fri 4pm PT. I can demo a 60s live prompt pipeline.
maria (Marketing): Proposed run-of-show (45 min total):
- 00:00–00:03 intro & housekeeping (maria)
- 00:03–00:12 benchmark story + key takeaways (raj + olivia)
- 00:12–00:20 live demo: Optimize + batching demo (sam)
- 00:20–00:30 panel Q&A + pre-submitted questions (all)
- 00:30–00:35 CTA + closing (kevin)
- 00:35–00:45 optional deep-dive breakout / sales follow-ups (kevin)
ops (Events): Add pre-show checklist: presenters join 20m early, headset check, recording consent. I posted the checklist in the event doc: https://docs.google.com/event-rehearsal (please add your confirmations).
maria (Marketing): Routing snippet for inbound leads (rough) — can we agree on this?
```
if lead.score >= 85 -> send to sales-sdr (tag: hot)
elif lead.company_size >= 100 -> send to enterprise-nurture
elif event_engagement >= 60% -> send to product-led-funnel
else -> marketing-nurture
```
kevin (Sales): Works. Implementation options: Zapier webhook from webinar platform -> /webhook/lead-router or direct Postgres upsert via event pipeline. Need 1 person owning handoff (I can).
olivia (Product): Abstract draft for registration page (short):
"When inference costs and latency collide, you don’t have to choose. Join Redwood engineers to see how production serving, batching, and caching cut costs while keeping SLAs. Live demo + benchmark deck."
maria (Marketing): Nice — keep it <140 chars for tweet preview. Also we should A/B the CTA button text: "Get a cost review" vs "Schedule a demo" and track which converts better.
sam (DevRel): For the demo I need a small dataset + 3 prompt examples. Can someone drop sample prompts in the rehearsal doc?
maria (Marketing): Done — added prompts + rehearsal slides. Link: https://docs.google.com/rehearsal-deck
presenter-bot: Reminder — recording consent form must be completed by all speakers at least 24h before event: https://forms.company/recording-consent :bell:
kevin (Sales): I’ll own the inbound mapping and follow-ups. Will add Zapier flow and test on Mon.
raj (Growth): I’ll prepare the two benchmark slides (baseline public model vs optimized config) and include a short note on measurement methodology.
maria (Marketing): Final asks: speakers confirm by EOD tomorrow, join rehearsal (Wed 9am PT is primary), and please be in #marketing-presenters 20m early on show day. Any blockers?
kevin (Sales): none here. :thumbsup:
olivia (Product): Confirmed. I’ll bring the Optimize config examples.
sam (DevRel): Confirmed — Wed 9am PT works.
ops (Events): I’ll schedule the 20m pre-show Zoom + stagehand channel.
maria (Marketing): Great — I’ll lock the registration page copy and send the calendar invites after the rehearsal slot is confirmed. Thanks team! :party:
